build_denoiser_model: build an LCMDenoiser model using LCMDenoiserTransformerFactory with DenoiserConfig and model dimensions
create_denoiser_config: create a DenoiserConfig dataclass with pos_embedding_style, timestep_embed_dim, and projection settings
build_denoiser_layer: build an LCMDenoiserLayer with self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward network components
build_timestep_embedder: build a DiTTimestepEncoder for diffusion timestep embeddings using the factory method
build_initial_projection: build the initial Projection layer mapping input_dim to model_dim for the denoiser
